_comment: Approved sources of manager-authored public writing for the letters research product.
Phase 0 (discovery only). Every active record is an SEC-hosted route: the filings a fund
or its registered fund files with EDGAR. Manager websites whose terms of use restrict
automated retrieval are recorded under 'excluded' with the reason, and are never fetched.
A source may be 'active' only when retrievalMode is 'automated_sec' and rightsJudgement is
'sec_public_record'. scripts/discover-letters.mjs refuses to run otherwise. One request per
active source per run: the filer's submissions index on data.sec.gov. Nothing else is read.
The CIKs for the three registered funds were written from memory and are checked against the
entity name EDGAR returns before a single filing is listed; a mismatch stops the run.
Filing index URLs are authoritative. A DFAN14A or Schedule 13D is stored under the subject
company's CIK folder, which the submissions index does not name, so no document URL is ever
inferred from the filer's CIK; enumerate-letters.mjs reads the folder off the index page.
Edit this file, not the script.
November 2026: ten sources added, each CIK and entity name read live from data.sec.gov on
2026-11-07 (verifiedOn). Activist sources also list SCHEDULE 13D and SCHEDULE 13D/A: EDGAR
has filed Schedule 13D under those form types since December 2024, and a source listing only
"SC 13D" stopped seeing new ones. A shareholder-report source says whether its report carries
the manager's letter (reportCarriesLetter), checked on one filing: open-end funds' tailored
reports since 2024 do not; closed-end funds' reports still do. fundSlug and organisation are
the site's 13F page and display name, for the review queue's record skeleton.
